excerpts.text: **405 Method Not Allowed** means the server knows the request method, but the target resource does not support it. The response must include an `Allow` header that lists the methods the resource does support, for example `Allow: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS`.
If the server does not recognise the method at all, [501 Not Implemented](/status-codes/501) is the right answer instead.
